notes:
- A new Home with posters, overviews and episode names for films and shows, and TMPlayer rows on the Android TV home screen
- A setup and a quick tour after sign in, in every language, with Performance and Mobile data steps; existing users are offered the tour once
- Low storage mode streams videos larger than the free space, and Save mobile data fetches only a few minutes ahead on mobile data
- Skip intro, recap and credits, speed remembered per series, preferred audio and subtitle language, watch later, season downloads, bookmarks, A-B repeat and skip silence
- Backups of settings and lists, an app PIN and a kids lock with allowed chats
- After a crash, TMPlayer asks before sending a report, once or always
- A macOS preview for Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 26 or newer
- New icons, the desktop's own window buttons, and many fixes for right-to-left languages, TV focus and long translations

Series now have an Episodes list in the player on phone, TV and desktop, with autoplay to the next episode and marking episodes watched right from the list. The side bar is simpler: Home, History, Favourites, Chats, Downloads and Settings, and Only my folders hides Telegram's own Chats and Saved groups. There is a shorter welcome tour, and Home says how to get a first video in. TMPlayer now asks before forgetting progress, clearing caches or deleting downloads. On desktop, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bengali, Malayalam, Arabic and Persian show even without system fonts, and the AppImage updates only what changed. On TV, OK pauses in one press and See all sits on each Home row. Labels that were cut short in German, Russian and Malayalam fit, and buttons in the light theme are readable again.

TMPlayer now speaks 21 languages (machine translated for now, corrections welcome on GitHub). Home has rows, series get their own page, and search covers all your chats. Optional posters and overviews come from TMDB, TVmaze and AniList, and subtitles can be found online through OpenSubtitles. The player adds volume boost, a sleep timer, a "still watching?" check, subtitle and audio delay, subtitle size and position, and simpler controls on phone, TV and desktop. Downloads can be removed after watching. On TV: Fire TV remotes, Watch Next and seek previews. On desktop the QR sign in works in release builds, and there is a new About screen everywhere.
Videos play on Android TV again. In 1.22.0 the player closed itself a few seconds into every video on a television; phones and computers were not affected.
Smaller downloads. The Android APK is about half its old size, and the Windows and Linux packages are a third to almost two thirds smaller. The Linux tarball is now a .tar.xz.

Finished episodes now get a tick, and any video can be marked as watched or unwatched by hand. A new Watched tab lists what you have finished. Searching a chat now finds videos outside the size limits, and the grid says how many videos the limits are hiding. On a TV, the release page opens as a QR code. On Windows, the media keys and the media flyout control the player.
The first release with a desktop app for Windows and Linux. It signs in with the same Telegram account and plays the same chats, with the keyboard, the mouse and your media keys.
